business_summary: Nebius Group N.V. is a Netherlands-domiciled, Nasdaq-listed neocloud GPU rental provider that scaled rapidly through 2025 alongside CoreWeave, drawing dedicated ETF coverage of the sector. It sits on the neocloud-gpu-rental link.

exposure_summary.narrative: 24/7 Wall St's coverage of a new neocloud-focused ETF names Nebius alongside CoreWeave as a soaring name in the sector, a dated third-party market-structure claim rather than a first-party disclosure; Nebius does not separately break out export-compliance-specific revenue within its GPU rental business.

disclosed_revenue_exposure.basis: No revenue-exposure percentage for this chain's link is disclosed in the sources on file: the mapping role_evidence carries a qualitative operating claim, not a segment revenue split.

latest_fy.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/NBIS.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)

revenue_cagr_3y.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/NBIS.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
revenue_cagr_3y.basis: Three-year CAGR computed as (529800000 / 13500000) ** (1/3) - 1 from companyfacts, fiscal year ended 2022-12-31 (13500000) to fiscal year ended 2025-12-31 (529800000). CAUTION: the 2022 base predates Nebius Group's 2024 restructuring out of Yandex N.V., so this is a tiny, pre-restructuring base and the resulting multiple should be read as early-stage ramp, not organic compounding.

operating_margin.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/NBIS.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
operating_margin.basis: Operating income -611700000 divided by revenue 529800000 for fiscal year ended 2025-12-31, both from companyfacts; a negative margin reflects an early build-out phase.

operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/NBIS.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.basis: Net cash from operating activities 384800000 divided by net income 82500000 for fiscal year ended 2025-12-31, both from companyfacts. Net income is positive despite a negative operating income, consistent with material non-operating items (e.g. investment or interest income) this profile does not decompose.

fcf_margin.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/NBIS.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
fcf_margin.basis: Free cash flow margin: operating cash flow 384800000 less capex 4066000000, divided by revenue 529800000, fiscal year ended 2025-12-31; deeply negative, consistent with an active GPU/data-center capex build-out well ahead of revenue.

net_debt_to_ebitda.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/NBIS.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
net_debt_to_ebitda.basis: Net debt 425100000 (total debt 4103200000 less cash 3678100000) divided by a negative EBITDA proxy -193800000 (operating income -611700000 plus depreciation 417900000), both as of fiscal year ended 2025-12-31, from companyfacts. CAUTION: EBITDA is negative, so this ratio is not a conventional leverage read; a negative multiple here signals build-out-phase operating losses against real debt, not deleveraging.

piotroski.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/NBIS.json quality, computed in the Actions venue over SEC EDGAR companyfacts with financetoolkit.models
piotroski.basis: Piotroski F-score 7 (state STRONG) computed over SEC companyfacts statements in data/market/NBIS.json quality.piotroski.

beneish_state.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/NBIS.json quality, computed in the Actions venue over SEC EDGAR companyfacts with financetoolkit.models
beneish_state.basis: Beneish M-score 45.613, state REVIEW (not CLEAN), computed over SEC companyfacts statements. An extreme M-score in a fast-growing, recently-restructured issuer often reflects large one-off accounting changes rather than manipulation, but the model does not distinguish the two; treat as a flag to examine the underlying statements, not a conclusion.

disposition.basis: Newly profiled to close the neocloud-gpu-rental OVER_CROWDED link's coverage gap. COMPLETE with two NULL canonical fields (both reverse_dcf, NOT_APPLICABLE on negative base FCF). confidence_audit.basis: Counts cover the canonical metric fields only. VERIFIED is a figure read directly off fetched fundamentals as reported. INFERRED is a figure computed from fetched fundamentals/quality, with the derivation named in its basis. SPECULATIVE is reserved for the reverse-DCF solve, whose discount rate and terminal growth are assumed. NULL is a field looked for in the fetched market file and not found, or not computable without mixing reporting periods, never estimated.

notes: Profiles are medium-depth reusable research. This file carries no final verdict, no entry zone and no red team; those belong to the deep-dive stage.
Data tier (T1/T2/T3) describes data availability. Opportunity tier (O1/O2/O3) describes research priority. Neither implies the other.
